home_meta_title: PadelIndex — Your level. Proven, not claimed.
home_meta_description: PadelIndex is the independent rating for amateur padel players. A Bayesian rating built for doubles, confirmed by your opponents, valid across every club. Try the match simulator to see how your rating moves.
home_og_description: A padel doubles rating from confirmed matches: opponent strength, score margin and confidence — not self-assessment.
home_hero_eyebrow: The rating for amateur padel players
home_hero_sub: PadelIndex measures how strong you really play — across club lines, from confirmed results, with a model built for doubles instead of chess.
home_problem_h2: Almost nobody really knows their level.
home_problem_p: Levels get guessed, ticked on a form, or handed out differently by every club. The moment you play somewhere else, the number means nothing. But the most common objection to a rating system checks out on paper — here it is.
home_gripe1_q: "I've clearly gotten better — the number just won't move."
home_gripe1_a: With PadelIndex your rating moves after every confirmed match, and you see exactly how much of that came from opponent strength, score margin, and your recent run.
home_gripe2_q: "That guy only plays in his own circle and suddenly he's at the top."
home_gripe2_a: Every result needs confirmation from the opposing team. Results without an opponent don't count — so made-up matches don't either.
home_gripe3_q: "Won 6:1, 6:2 and the rating didn't move at all. I don't get it."
home_gripe3_a: That's why we show the math: after every match, you see exactly what changed and why — even when the number doesn't feel right.
home_rating_p: No questionnaire, no guessed value: PadelIndex calculates from opponent strength, score margin and confirmation by the opposing team — with the exact same code that runs the live ratings. Try the rating simulator yourself.
home_tokens_p: You earn tokens for every confirmed match. Redeem them at your club — for coaching sessions, equipment, or entry fees. Like frequent-flyer miles, just for padel.
home_vereine_h2: The rating runs on your own site.
home_vereine_p_pre: From here on it's not about your own level anymore, it's about your club — if you're only here as a player right now,
home_vereine_p_post: above is already everything you need. For clubs: one line of code, and the ranking runs on your website, in your colors, with zero plugin chaos.
home_liga_h2: Real club leagues run on PadelIndex too.
home_liga_p: The BÁVARO PADEL LEAGUE at STC Oberland plays in 4-player boxes with rotating doubles partners, its own box standings and promotion/relegation — a standalone ranking alongside the general PadelIndex level. Results also feed into the Index rating.
home_ratgeber_h2: Rules, equipment, technique and tactics, explained simply.
home_ratgeber_p: The PadelIndex guides cover everything from your first serve to doubles tactics — and the quiz, with three difficulty levels, lets you test how confident you really are.
home_cta_p: We're starting in the Oberland region. Sign up and we'll reach out once your club is on board — or we'll ask them for you.
hseq_note: Calculated with the model that runs in production — opponent strength, score margin, and how well the system already knows you.
